description: Vector Decision Model (VDM) library for .NET written in G#: typed Choice, Score and Noul decisions, collection operations, outcome stores and trainable heads over the embeddings you already have. Based on the principles of Venn (markrussinovich/venn-vdm).

Optional reader adapter for Hyperplane.NET: CiderEmbedder turns any Cider.NET IEmbeddingBackend (including Cider.Native's in-process llama.cpp LlamaEmbedder over GGUF models) into a Hyperplane IEmbedder with an honest, provenance-derived experimental profile.

Local HTTP server for Hyperplane vector decision models: the Decisions API (/api/alpha/decisions) plus Venn-compatible routes for outcome decisions, families, indexes, prepared questions, streaming index application and calibrations.

Mapeo explícito sin reflexión: cada mapeo es una clase escrita a mano (IMapper en memoria, IProjection para IQueryable y EF Core), registrada en la inyección de dependencias. Proyecciones anidadas con Inline, que Expand sustituye para que EF Core las traduzca. Comprueba los registros al arrancar.

Cron for .NET: parse cron expressions (seconds, years, L, W, #, +), find next and previous occurrences in any TimeZoneInfo with correct daylight saving time handling, describe schedules in plain language, and run scheduled jobs. No dependencies.

The .NET SDK for the Casazium License Server: activate and verify license keys, verify signed license files offline, lock a license to a machine, and check for updates. For WPF, WinForms, MAUI, Avalonia, console apps and Unity.
edsdcf-check: command-line validator for CiA 306 EDS and DCF files, built on the EdsDcfNet rule catalog.
Compiler and coroutine contracts shared by Hyperbee.Expressions and its compilers.
C# binding for zimodem running as a host library, giving a Hayes-compatible Wi-Fi modem with no ESP32 needed.
CrCore.Maui is a .NET MAUI library: controls, converters, and more, built with a focus on performance and simplicity.
Offline validation and parsing of the 14-digit Egyptian national ID number (الرقم القومي): birth date, gender and governorate. Accepts Arabic-Indic digits.
